title: Asking About a Span: mettől meddig?

sections.title: The one suffix that ignores vowel harmony
sections.content: Quick reminder: -ig ("until/to") is always -ig, no matter what the word sounds like — one of the rare suffixes that ignores vowel harmony entirely. Now that -tól/-től ... -ig covers days and months too, here's how to ask about a span instead of just stating one.

items.english: I work from Monday to Friday.
I'm here from morning until evening.

sections.content: -ig not harmonizing is unusual, but it makes it one less thing to think about — the same -ig fits after any word, back-vowel or front-vowel, every time.

The question forms are mettől ("from when") and meddig ("until when", also "how long") — Mettől meddig dolgozol? asks "from when to when do you work?", answered with exactly the -tól/-től ... -ig pattern from this lesson.
